title: Fixing a Hole - Wikipedia
notes: Recorded 9 February 1967 at Regent Sound, the lead vocal live with the rhythm track; overdubs 21 February at EMI. Structure: intro, verse, verse, bridge, verse, verse (guitar solo), bridge, verse, outro (fadeout). "Ringo Starr's hi-hat in the final measure of this introduction introduces a swing beat that stays for the remainder of the song." Personnel: Ringo Starr – drums.

title: Lovely Rita - Wikipedia
notes: Recording began 23 February 1967, eight takes for the basic track: Harrison's guitar on track 1, Lennon's on 2, "Ringo Starr's drums on track 3", McCartney's piano on 4. Martin's second piano for the solo added 21 March. Personnel: Ringo Starr – drums, comb and tissue paper.

title: Baby, You're a Rich Man - Wikipedia
notes: Recorded 11 May 1967 at Olympic Sound Studios, Barnes, in a six-hour session; twelve takes before a satisfactory rhythm track. Released 7 July 1967 (UK) as the B-side of All You Need Is Love; on Capitol's US Magical Mystery Tour LP (November 1967). The NME (July 1967) heard an "unusual shuffle beat, emphasised by handclaps". Personnel: Ringo Starr – drums, tambourine, maracas, handclaps.
